_note: Install-guide extras per wiring sub-page. Only SOURCED lines (with source) or explicit UNVERIFIED/PROPOSED tags. Wire steps are generated from each page's net table. tier: CRITICAL = needed for a safe first drive, LATER = refine over time.

clamp.why: THROTTLE_TRIM_ENABLE=0 for first drive: the Teensy throttle clamp is not in the drive path yet (docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md).
safety: Power off and the MSD pulled before any harness change (shop log First drive).
test: Recheck the pedal curve with the 100k pull-down fitted: 0/25/50/75/100 % × wiper, ±2 % (docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md)
Scope U1 pulse width, target 3–8 ms (docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md)

enables.why: Dual-Teensy enables act through the clamp (U1/U2), which is off for first drive (THROTTLE_TRIM_ENABLE=0).
test: Kill either heartbeat (pin 4 or pin 7): Kelly throttle must go to 0 V (docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md)

safety: Kelly is disabled while the park brake is set: pole 3 NC opens Foot_SW (docs/PARK_BRAKE.md)
test: Brake set + full throttle → 0 RPM (Kelly Foot Switch checked) (docs/PARK_BRAKE.md)
Photo of the lever for switch fit (BACKLOG)

safety: SERVICE: step 1 pull the MSD, step 2 pull all 4 A6T200 before touching packs or the bus (Mechanic 2026-10-21)
EV200HAANA has a built-in economizer: no external coil suppression (shop log 2026-10-20 06:31)
test: Precharge: mains never close unless Kelly side ≥95 % of the lowest string within 3 s; 2 retries 30 s apart, then lockout (Config.h kPcDual*)
Weld check before precharge: bus voltage with mains commanded open (BACKLOG, REQUIRED)

safety: NC1 is the series cut for every coil + Kelly KSI; NC2 is logging only, never the cut. No interposing relay (docs/ESTOP.md)
test: Press the e-stop with mains closed: both EV200s + AEV14012 drop and Kelly powers off (docs/ESTOP.md)
Confirm NC block DC rating vs ≈7.6 A make (BACKLOG)

safety: X2 pin 9 BICM 5 V never to Teensy I/O; Teensy pins are 3.3 V only (PJRC; repo docs)
test: Cells appear on serial; if none, swap CAN_H/CAN_L (H/L unconfirmed)
BICM temps vs a thermometer, then TEMPS_VERIFIED=1 (docs/TEMPS.md)
Dead-LEM: each output ≈2.5 V at 0 A; within 0.2 V of a rail = dead (Sparky, BACKLOG)

kelly.why: Fail-safe Low cap engages when the Teensys are dead or a LEM is dead (hard limp).
test: Relay de-energised (Teensy off): full pedal stays ≤ cap RPM (docs/DRIVE_MODES.md)
Confirm the ECO pin on the harness (UNVERIFIED)

safety: Hold the 12 V− chassis bond until the DC-DC isolation test passes (shop log 2026-10-15 20:46)
test: DC-DC TDC-JH isolation: power off, pack ± to 12 V− open / ≥1 MΩ (shop log 2026-10-15 20:46)
12 V low alarm at 11.5 V (PROPOSED, REQUIRED)
